issues.explanation: Register validates via a rules() method instead of the project's #[Validate] + $this->validate() attribute pattern used by Login.
Login duplicates authentication with Auth::attempt plus a manual LOWER(email) query, Hash::check and Auth::login fallback that the task does not require.
No unauthorized-call test for the Livewire submit actions (for example an authenticated user calling Login/Register submit), which the conventions definition of done requires.
Register hits the IP rate limiter before validation, so failed validations consume the 5-attempt budget.

conventions.evidence: Redirects use route()/redirectRoute() (LogoutController.php:107, Register.php:351); views use route() and __(); Login uses #[Validate] (Login.php:225) but Register uses rules() (Register.php:362-370) diverging from the #[Validate] project pattern.

readability.evidence: Small focused methods (submit/render/throttleKey), clear names, consistent Blade/Bulma structure, no dead code or debug output; e.g. NewPasswordController.php:140, Login.php:234.

requirements.evidence: Login rate-limit/auth.failed/session-regenerate/intended redirect (Login.php:234-254, throttleKey Login.php:295-298); Register strict+unique/confirmed/defaults/transliterate key/Registered/login (Register.php:330-388, AppServiceProvider.php:429); logout/home/guest/forgot/reset/verify routes and controllers plus pt_BR/en ui files and phpunit locale pins.

scope.evidence: Every hunk serves auth/localization: routes, Livewire, controllers, views, lang, config, phpunit pins, auth tests, CHANGELOG; welcome/bulma-test edits only add route() and __() as required.

security.evidence: Server-side validation everywhere (Login #[Validate], Register rules, controllers $request->validate); rate limits on login/register/forgot/resend; signed+throttled verify via EmailVerificationRequest; always-same forgot status; remember_token rotation (NewPasswordController.php:151-154); {{ }} escaping; auth/verified/guest middleware.

simplicity.evidence: Mostly lean reuse of Password::defaults, Password broker, EmailVerificationRequest; but Login.php:262-280 adds a redundant manual LOWER(email)+Hash::check+Auth::login path beside Auth::attempt, and Register.php:335 hits limiter before validate.

tests.evidence: Pest tests for login pt-BR/happy/auth.failed/rate-limit/redirect (LoginTest), register happy/unverified/Registered/VerifyEmail/confirmed/defaults/unique/rate-limit (RegisterTest), logout, password reset single-email/throttle/token/remember_token, verification tampered-id/forbidden/resend/throttle, localization; missing Livewire unauthorized-call tests.

review.summary: Full session auth flow with pt-BR localization, rate limiting, signed verification and password reset is implemented per contract with extensive Pest coverage. Minor nits remain (Register rules() vs #[Validate], duplicate login fallback, missing Livewire unauthorized-call tests), so approve with nits.
